description: {name} case study: an admissions website with programme listings and an apply-now form, plus social creative and ads, from MMC.
brief: {name} is an autonomous engineering college. We built a website around admissions: a homepage with programme listings and an apply-now enquiry form, on desktop and mobile.

Admissions is the action, so the apply-now form sits directly under the hero on desktop and inside the first screen on a phone, with the programmes beneath. Admissions social creative, a Meta lead ad and a Google search listing sit alongside it.

showcases.title: College homepage on desktop and mobile
showcases.text: A student-led hero with the reasons to choose the college, why MVJCE, the environment and placements, set out as steps, and the same page on a phone with a campus video.

showcases.title: The same page on a phone
showcases.text: The enquiry form sits inside the first phone screen and the programme cards follow.

showcases.title: Apply-now enquiry form
showcases.text: Name, email, mobile number and programme choice in a single row on desktop.

showcases.title: Social creative, a Meta lead ad and a Google search listing
showcases.text: Admissions messaging in the same colours as the site.
